import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked')
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")

print("Total paragraphs:", len(paras))
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
    style = None
    if pPr:
        styles = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
        if styles:
            style = styles[0].getAttribute("w:val")
    # gather text
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    text = "".join(texts)
    if style and any(s in style.lower() for s in ("head", "title", "headline")):
        print(f"[{i}] style={style!r} text={text!r}")

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
NS = {'w': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
tree = ET.parse('unpacked/word/document.xml')
root = tree.getroot()

paras = root.findall('.//w:p', NS)
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    pPr = p.find('w:pPr', NS)
    style = None
    if pPr is not None:
        st = pPr.find('w:pStyle', NS)
        if st is not None:
            style = st.get(W + 'val')
    text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.findall('.//w:t', NS))
    # run formatting summary
    run_info = []
    for r in p.findall('w:r', NS):
        rPr = r.find('w:rPr', NS)
        flags = []
        if rPr is not None:
            for child in rPr:
                tag = child.tag.replace(W, '')
                if tag in ('b', 'i', 'u', 'strike'):
                    flags.append(tag)
        rt = r.find('w:t', NS)
        rtext = rt.text if rt is not None and rt.text else ""
        run_info.append(f"[{''.join(flags)}]{rtext!r}")
    print(f"[{i}] style={style!r} runs={run_info}")

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
NS = {'w': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
tree = ET.parse('unpacked/word/document.xml')
root = tree.getroot()

paras = root.findall('.//w:p', NS)
for i in [0, 2, 5, 7, 14, 16]:
    p = paras[i]
    print(f"=== Paragraph {i} ===")
    for r in p.findall('w:r', NS):
        rPr = r.find('w:rPr', NS)
        rpr_str = ""
        if rPr is not None:
            rpr_str = ET.tostring(rPr, encoding='unicode')
        rt = r.find('w:t', NS)
        print("  rPr:", rpr_str)
        print("  text:", (rt.text if rt is not None else None))

# Also check styles.xml default sizes / heading styles
print("\n=== styles.xml styles ===")
try:
    stree = ET.parse('unpacked/word/styles.xml')
    for s in stree.getroot().findall('w:style', NS):
        sid = s.get(W + 'styleId')
        stype = s.get(W + 'type')
        name = s.find('w:name', NS)
        nval = name.get(W + 'val') if name is not None else None
        print(f"  styleId={sid!r} type={stype!r} name={nval!r}")
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("  no styles.xml")

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
NS = {'w': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
ET.register_namespace('w', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main')

RPR_ORDER = ['rStyle','rFonts','b','bCs','i','iCs','caps','smallCaps','strike','dstrike',
             'outline','shadow','emboss','imprint','noProof','snapToGrid','vanish','webHidden',
             'color','spacing','w','kern','position','sz','szCs','highlight','u','effect','bdr',
             'shd','fitText','vertAlign','rtl','cs','em','lang','eastAsianLayout','specVanish','oMath']
U_POS = RPR_ORDER.index('u')

def add_underline(r):
    rPr = r.find('w:rPr', NS)
    if rPr is None:
        rPr = ET.Element(W + 'rPr')
        r.insert(0, rPr)
    if rPr.find('w:u', NS) is not None:
        return False
    u = ET.Element(W + 'u', {W + 'val': 'single'})
    idx = None
    for i, child in enumerate(rPr):
        tag = child.tag.replace(W, '')
        pos = RPR_ORDER.index(tag) if tag in RPR_ORDER else len(RPR_ORDER)
        if pos > U_POS:
            idx = i
            break
    if idx is None:
        rPr.append(u)
    else:
        rPr.insert(idx, u)
    return True

tree = ET.parse('unpacked/word/document.xml')
root = tree.getroot()

headlines = []
for p in root.findall('.//w:p', NS):
    text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.findall('.//w:t', NS))
    if text and text.isupper():
        headlines.append((text, p))

total = 0
for text, p in headlines:
    n = sum(1 for r in p.findall('w:r', NS) if add_underline(r))
    total += n
    print(f"headline: {text!r} runs underlined: {n}")

print("headlines found:", len(headlines), "| total runs underlined:", total)
tree.write('unpacked/word/document.xml', encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
print("saved")
